file_change.purpose: Define the minimum durable explicit Governance acceptance and lineage representation without circular self-authorization.
implementation: Define Draft 2020-12 JSON schema for acceptance identity, Planning/Build stage, governed subject identity, actor, ACCEPT decision, predecessor authority, evidence references, and resulting accepted state.
Require all authority and evidence references to be explicit non-empty identities rather than inferred repository or platform activity.
The resulting state SHALL NOT equal the predecessor authority, preventing the candidate accepted state from serving as its own prerequisite.
Build acceptance resulting_state carries the accepted implementation state identity; richer separated evidence classes and rejection-history records remain deferred.
